_comment: THE PUBLIC RECIPE (recipes/train_public_nm6k.sh): the stage-2 configuration of the released v2 model applied directly to gliner2.5-multi-v1 on the published nm-kvkk-pii-6K set, no private input. 4,000 steps with a checkpoint every 500; score every checkpoint and keep the one that is best on real documents if you have any (in-distribution scores keep rising after real-document scores fall). The released models add a stage on pseudonymised real text before this step, so expect somewhat lower real-document scores.
